name: Text Link Directory

sources.title: Text Link Directory homepage - free human-edited web directory, online since 2005
Submission Guidelines - 3 submission types, URL/title/description rules

conditions: Free submission is reviewed in 30-60 days
Free + reciprocal link to textlinkdirectory.com is reviewed within 30 days; their robot checks for the link
'Top Websites' paid option: $5 one-time, review within 24h, link placed at top of category page above free and reciprocal listings
requirements: Pick the most specific category/sub-category — many rejections are for wrong category
Not accepted: sites with illegal content, redirects to another URL, under-construction sites, mirror sites with identical content, and sites that are mostly affiliate links
Title: must be the company/site name, max 55 characters including spaces
Description: minimum 150 and max 300 characters, no superlatives ('best', 'great'), no '#1' or '$' signs, no promotional advertising copy
preparation: Best-fit category (the 'Add URL' link lives inside each category page)
If going reciprocal: a link 'Text Link Directory' → https://www.textlinkdirectory.com/ no more than one click from your homepage
workflow: Browse https://www.textlinkdirectory.com/ to the most specific category/sub-category
Click the 'Add URL' link on that category page
Choose submission type: Free / Free+Reciprocal / Top Websites ($5)
Enter URL, title (≤55 chars), and description (150-300 chars, no promo language)
If reciprocal: place the return link — their robot verifies it
Wait: 30-60 days free, ~30 days reciprocal, ~24h paid
watchFor: Human-edited with strict copy rules — promotional descriptions are rejected; keep it factual
The submit entry point is per-category, not a global form — submitting from the wrong category is a stated rejection reason
Sites heavy on affiliate links are explicitly banned — an affiliate-heavy landing page will fail
Reciprocal link must stay live; the robot re-checks
Copyright footer says 2005-2011 — the guidelines page is old; verify the queue is still processed before investing effort
countsAsLive: The site appears as a link entry on its category page (and at top-of-category for paid 'Top Websites')
unknowns: Whether the directory still actively reviews (guidelines page is dated; homepage content unchanged since ~2011)
Whether listing links are dofollow (catalog note says follow; unconfirmed)
